quote: Supply Agreement § 2.2: The Agreement "shall **automatically renew** for successive five-year Renewal Terms" unless either Party gives notice of non-renewal "not more than 270 days and not less than 240 days before the expiration of the Initial Term or the then-current Renewal Term." ... The non-renewal notice window is a narrow 30-day band (240–270 days before expiration)... If it misses that window, it is locked in for another five years (through March 1, 2032)
